# Generated files - do not edit by hand

Everything in this folder is written by the sync Action in the `aintkaran/originals` repo. Add photos, edit captions or reorder there. The next sync overwrites any change made here.

Per project folder: `web/` holds the optimized WebP and JPEG XL exports, and `meta.json` carries the public metadata - title, caption, credit, alt and the camera EXIF allow-list (no GPS, serials or dates). `manifest.json` at the top is what the gallery reads.
